title: Advisory: Contractor Credential Abuse Leading to Ransomware
issued_for: Water and wastewater utilities and their managed service providers
summary: A regional water utility suffered a ransomware intrusion that began with a reused third-party maintenance credential lacking multi-factor authentication.
background: The attacker authenticated to an internet-facing remote access portal on 4 September 2024 and maintained a low-profile foothold for eight days before escalating to domain administrator and deploying file-encrypting malware across eleven servers.

technical_details.heading: Initial access
technical_details.body: A contractor credential unused for rotation in fourteen months and not protected by multi-factor authentication was used against an internet-facing remote access portal.

technical_details.heading: Lateral movement
technical_details.body: A common open-source post-exploitation framework was used to reach a domain controller, where two rogue administrator accounts were created and network-share backups were deleted before encryption.

recommended_actions.action: Rotate all contractor and third-party credentials and enforce multi-factor authentication on every remote access path.
Isolate backup infrastructure so that domain administrator accounts cannot reach or delete it.
Deploy endpoint detection and response agents across all servers and engineering workstations.

handling_caveat: For Official Use Only. Do not distribute outside partner utility security teams without originator approval.
